unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 实验
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I couldn't concentrate on the experiment.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：ex（出）+ peri（尝试）+ ment（名词后缀）= 实验。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 熟练的；内行的；专家的；经验丰富的 `n.` 专家；行家；能手
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: AI experts will have important jobs.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ex(出众) + pert(灵巧) -> 某领域的专家。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 说明；解释
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can you explain why the time is different...?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：Ex- (出) + Plain (平坦/清晰)，把事情变清晰说出来就是‘解释’。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 表露；表达；表示 `adj.` 快速的 `n.` 特快列车
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is very important to express properly in daily life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. 表露；表达；表示 adj. 快速的 n. 特快列车。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 现实，实际情况；事实，真相
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Some interesting facts about the Summer Olympics
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：f + act（行动/做） -> 做过的事情就是“事实；真相”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` [C] (`pl.` factories) 工厂
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We took a school trip to a factory.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: fac（脸）+ tory（托里）：托里的脸在工厂里被熏黑了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 失败，不及格，未能(做到) `n.` (考试)不及格
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It's OK to fail.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: fa(发)+il(生病)：考试失败(fail)了，急得都快要生病了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 公平的，公正的；合理的；白皙的，浅色的 `n.` 就业展览会，展销
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The whole project achieved a very fair result.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：adj. 公平的，公正的；合理的；白皙的，浅色的 n. 就业展览会，展销。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 落下，跌落 `n.` (`= autumn`) 秋天
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Come to the library on Tuesdays after school and fall in love with books!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: f + all，所有人都跌倒了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 著名的，出名的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Xu Xiake is one of the most famous travellers in China.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: fame（名声）+ ous（形容词后缀）-> 著名的

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (1) 风扇，扇子；(2) 迷，狂热爱好者
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Let's make a fan.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 夏天吹电风扇(fan)

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 距离远的，远方的，遥远的 `adv.` 远，非常
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I can't jump very far.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: f(飞)+ar(阿姨)：阿姨“飞”(f)到了很远(far)的地方。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 农场，农庄 `v.` 务农，种田
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is very important to farm properly in daily life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 农场，农庄 v. 务农，种田。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 农民，农场主
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The students had an active discussion about the farmer.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 农民，农场主。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 快的；迅速的 `adv.` 快地；迅速地
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can you run fast?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: f(飞)+as(如)+t(天)：飞得像天一样快(fast)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 肥的；肥胖的 `n.` 脂肪，肥肉
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Eating fat is important for keeping us healthy.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“发它”，联想：吃了太多脂肪，身体就像面团一样发它（发酵膨胀）变胖了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 特别受喜爱的 `n.` 受宠的人，得到偏爱的人
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The whole project achieved a very favourite (AmE favorite) result.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：adj. 特别受喜爱的 n. 受宠的人，得到偏爱的人。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 害怕；惧怕；担忧 `v.` 害怕；惧怕
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is very important to fear properly in daily life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 害怕；惧怕；担忧 v. 害怕；惧怕。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 喂养，提供(意见或信息等)，供给，饲养 `n.` 进料，动物的饲料，一次喂奶
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Feed the dog.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：f(食物food)+eed(看作两只眼睛) -> 盯着食物(f)，喂养(feed)小宠物。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 感觉到，体会，觉得，相信，摸起来，意识到 `n.` 感觉，气氛，理解，手感，触摸
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Sometimes Mum feels tired.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：f(风)+eel(鳗鱼) -> 感受(feel)到海风中鳗鱼的味道。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 感觉，情感，想法，态度、意见，看法
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can you read with feeling?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: feel (感觉) + ing，正在感受的情感。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 发烧；发热
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I have a fever and a bad headache.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 飞(fe)吻发热(ver)，发烧了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det. & adj.` 不多，很少, 几个，有些 `pron.` 很少人(或事物、地方)，一些
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: a few times
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆法：飞舞（落叶很少，只剩几片在空中飞舞）

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 田，地；牧场，运动场，实地，野外，领域 `v.` 处理，应付
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What are the people doing on the sports field?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: f + ield (田野)，在田野上奔跑。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 打仗，战斗，打架，努力争取；为……而斗争；(和……)争吵 `n.` 打架，战斗
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The Russian people built this museum to remember their fight against the Nazis during World War II.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 形似联想: 战士们在深夜 (night) 依然英勇战斗 (fight)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (使)充满；装满；填满
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Slowly, we filled many baskets.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: f（饭）+ ill（病）：饭装满了碗，吃到病了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 电影；影片，胶卷 `v.` 拍摄电影
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is the film about?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法：发音类似“飞马”。很多经典电影 (film) 开场经常有一个飞马的标志。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 最终的；最后的 `n.` 决赛
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I went into the final exam with great confidence.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: fine 的亲戚，最后（final）一关

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 找到，发现，发觉，查明，找出
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is very important to find properly in daily life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. 找到，发现，发觉，查明，找出。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 健康的；身体很好的；晴朗的；(只用于名词前)高质量的；美好的 `v.` 对……处以罚款
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The plants are fine.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: I'm fine, thank you.
